thread:
opsbot: 🚨 ALERT: billing.ingest backlog detected for eu-prod — windowing delayed >12m. Potential retroactive overage flags. Paging SRE oncall: Maya
Maya: on it, joining now.
Rafael: looking at kafka consumer metrics — partition lag spike ~25k, billing-ingest pods restarted 4x in last 10m.
Priya: I'm seeing shadow counts showing duplicate token ids around the same timestamps — could be replay/commit issue.
Maya: immediate mitigation: scaling billing-ingest consumers to 6 replicas. running: `kubectl scale deployment/billing-ingest --replicas=6 -n billing`
opsbot: runbook step executed: increase-consumer-parallelism.
Elena: got DM from a customer (ACME) about an unexpected overage email 10m ago.
Tom (Finance): heads up — billing-runner hasn't closed the 00:00-00:15 UTC window because ingest window is stalled. If backfill replays tokens, customers could see retroactive adjustments.
Priya: thought: replay likely due to proxy retries causing duplicate delivery. We can dedupe at aggregation but need short-term stop-gap.
Rafael: can we cut retries on the gateway? propose setting `MAX_RETRIES=1` then rolling update. lower retries avoids duplicate events.
Maya: applying env change to proxy now: `kubectl set env deployment/proxy MAX_RETRIES=1 -n gateway` — rolling update in progress.
opsbot: /incidents mute-alerts billing.overage.eu-prod 20m — auto overage alerts muted to prevent noise.
Elena: drafting customer notice: "We're investigating delayed usage reports; charges may be updated. We'll notify once reconciliation completes." Posting draft to #support-drafts.
Maya: starting a controlled backfill once consumers catch up: `jobs/start-backfill --topic=usage-eu --from-offset=<safe> --to-latest` (will monitor for replays).
Priya: we'll also trigger dedupe in aggregation by idempotency key for that window to prevent double-counting.
Tom (Finance): ok, pause billing emails until backfill/dedupe completes. Finance needs a log of any sent customer emails for audit.
Rafael: after scaling, lag dropped: partitions down to ~200 then trending to 0 over 3m. consumers stable.
Maya: proxy rollout finished, no further restarts observed.
opsbot: RESOLVED: ingestion-backlog-eu cleared. Created incident record INC-2026-042.
Elena: I'll push the customer update and open support tickets referencing INC-2026-042.
Priya: will run dedupe job overnight and attach checksum/artifact to the incident.
Maya: oncall will remain until handoff in 30m. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Rafael: note for postmortem: add a circuit-breaker to proxy retry logic and add consumer liveness alert granularity.
Tom (Finance): Finance will schedule reconciliation and small retroactive adjustments if needed.
opsbot: Summary added to incident log: "Root cause: transient proxy retry amplification + consumer restart loop -> kafka replay -> duplicate counts in shadow windows. Mitigation: scaled consumers, reduced proxy retries, muted overage alerts, backfill + dedupe, customer notifications queued." Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-042
